issues.legal_issue: A valid permanent proprietary allotment of acquired evacuee agricultural land gives the displaced person an enforceable right to that land.
material_facts: The allottee was a displaced person with a verified agricultural-land claim that had been only partly satisfied.
The settlement authorities found him entitled to further land, and the disputed land was validly allotted to him in permanent proprietary ownership.
A sanad was issued for the allotment, and possession was delivered to him; records showed his possession until the land was mistakenly entered in the Custodian’s area during consolidation.
issues.conclusion: The allottee had an enforceable right in the land validly allotted to him.
issues.legal_principle: Under Rule 67A of the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Rules, 1955, a displaced person from the specified areas whose verified agricultural-land claim remained unsatisfied could receive compensation through transfer of acquired evacuee agricultural land according to the quasi-permanent allotment scale. Rule 72(2) required the Settlement Officer, upon finding the allotment consistent with that scheme, to transfer the allotted land in permanent ownership and issue a sanad. The Court also considered the statutory framework governing acquired evacuee property, including sections 10, 12 and 14 of the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1954, and relied on Amar Singh v. Custodian, Evacuee Property, Punjab for the history and incidents of the allotment scheme.

rule.if: displaced_person_compensation_case and verified_land_claim_partially_unsatisfied and valid_permanent_land_allotment and possession_delivered

predicates.displaced_person_compensation_case: The proceeding concerns compensation or rehabilitation land allotted to a displaced person.
predicates.verified_land_claim_partially_unsatisfie: The displaced person had a verified land claim that remained partly unsatisfied.
predicates.valid_permanent_land_allotment: The responsible authorities validly allotted the land to the person in permanent ownership.
predicates.possession_delivered: The authorities delivered possession of the allotted land to the person.

issues.definition: When a displaced person’s verified land claim remains partly unsatisfied and the person receives a valid permanent allotment and possession in a compensation proceeding, the person has an enforceable right to the allotted land.
